boundary: harness-only composition around the existing OpenCode sprint launcher

owners.role: existing clickable product entrypoint; not modified by this harness sprint
existing OpenCode sprint launcher; accepts -PromptPath and -PlanOnly
existing bounded GNHF worktree sprint engine
harness-owned composition runner that snapshots prompt input once and binds preflight and execution to the same artifact

knownFailure.symptom: A PlanOnly launch reports Prompt: clipboard, exits successfully without starting GNHF, and a later execution must read the clipboard again.
knownFailure.risk: The prompt can change between preflight and execution, so the second launch is not cryptographically or artifact-bound to what was preflighted.
knownFailure.fieldEvidence: Observed 2026-08-08: PlanOnly consumed a 7094-character clipboard prompt and explicitly reported that no GNHF or provider process was started.
knownFailure.harnessRule: Clipboard may be an intake source only. Preflight and execution must consume one materialized prompt artifact with one recorded digest.

forbidden: Do not require the operator to copy the prompt again after preflight.
Do not treat clipboard contents as durable continuation evidence.
Do not write the raw prompt into JSON receipts, CI logs, PR bodies, or tracked files.
Do not bypass the existing OpenCode/GNHF launchers or duplicate their lifecycle logic.
Do not mutate product code, governance, secrets, or live targets from this harness lane.
